main.description: A voice recording and/or transcription captured by a Pebble Index ring and delivered by its webhook.

transcription.description: Plain-text transcription of the recording, when the webhook carried one.

audio.description: The audio recording (AAC-LC in an M4A container, mono, 16kHz), when the webhook carried one.

recordedAt.description: When the recording was captured on the ring.

trigger.description: The ring gesture that started the recording.

client.description: The capture device, as reported by the webhook. Always "ring" today.

recordingId.description: The Pebble app's identifier for the recording, taken from the audio part's filename.
